messages:
Maya: Morning async — quick standup.
Maya: Yesterday: landed slot allocator fix, ran microbatch benchmarks on a c4.2x instance. No regression on throughput.
Maya: Blocker: saw a KV eviction spike during a long-sequence soak test — reproduced locally once, still investigating root cause.
Maya: Today: add tracing to eviction path + open PR for allocator guard rails.
Sam: noted CI flake on kernel-integration; failing on prefetch ordering intermittently. Might be related.
Ian: saw the same failure earlier this week. Happy to pair on the eviction repro this afternoon. Which commit did you use for the bench?
Maya: benched on commit 0f9a8e3 — command I used: `./tools/bench/microbatch --model=gpt-small --iters=200 --seq=1024`. p95 went from ~48ms -> ~46ms after the allocator tweak.
Lucy: pushed a micro-optimization in kv-cache: avoid memcpy when slot refcount == 1. Local perf: +3% throughput on small model.
Maya: can you open a PR for that?
Lucy: yup — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/432 (WIP; tests failing on amd64).
OpsBot: Deploy started: canary group 'staging-runtime' — build 2026.03.15-77.
Sam: for the CI flake I'm going to annotate `test_prefetch_ordering` flaky so we can land the hotfix; will follow up with a real fix later.
Ian: I'll take the eviction instrumentation work. @Maya can you add minimal repro steps and logs to the issue so I can pick it up?
Maya: done — created issue #890 and attached the reproducer and heap traces.
Lucy: heads-up: I'll be OOO midday, back after 4pm PT.
Sam: quick CR ping for @Ian on PR #428 (slot allocator cleanup). Small change, mostly comments.
Ian: ack — will review before lunch and leave comments inline.
Maya: plan: if the eviction spike appears in staging canary we roll back that build and block further rollouts until we have the tracing data.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks everyone — post any follow-ups in this thread or ping me directly for pairing.
